title: FreightOS agent manifest
description: Operational override of the handoff manifest schema, authorised by ADR-0015 and ADR-0018. Changes: (1) `planes` is replaced by `legal_authority_class` + `operating_contexts` per ADR-0015; (2) `module` becomes required so the autonomy ceiling can be computed rather than trusted; (3) `additionalProperties` is tightened from true to false, because a manifest that silently accepts unknown keys cannot enforce Constitution Art. IV.1 (agents operate only within manifests). `maximum_autonomy` here is a DECLARED ceiling and is never the effective one — see ADR-0018.

module.description: Key in config/scope/module_states.yaml. Required so effectiveMaximumAutonomy() can clamp against the module's state and horizon.

legal_authority_class.description: ADR-0015. The regulatory posture. Operating context never widens it.

maximum_autonomy.description: DECLARED ceiling only. The effective ceiling is min(this, module ceiling, horizon ceiling) — ADR-0018. No consumer may use this value directly.

allowed_tools.description: Empty means no tool may be called. 14_TEST_AND_ACCEPTANCE_STRATEGY requires that agents cannot call unlisted tools; the tool registry is a Phase 2 deliverable, so empty is the correct Phase 0 value.

allOf.description: ADR-0015 rule 6: the declared legal class constrains which operating contexts an agent may run in.
